scope: Tracker/project organization and implementation ticket creation only. No execution, provisioning, credentials, live requests or spending.

milestones.name: Specification agreed
milestones.description: Approved planning map and its 20 completed decision/research tickets.

milestones.name: Local chess and exact rules
milestones.description: Build foundation, orthodox rules, archives, continuous clocks, checked proofs/pending and guest lifecycle.

milestones.name: AI opponents and accessible play
milestones.description: Direct browser providers, full-history caching/accounting, catalog/diagnostics, queued switches and approved accessible Classic workspace.

milestones.name: Private accounts and hosted operations
milestones.description: Google PKCE, owner-only sync/conflicts, free-tier staging and verified encrypted backup/restore before public account storage.

milestones.name: Native acceptance and launch
milestones.description: Integrated invariants, actual desktop/mobile AT, authorized live routes/cache/cost, security/license review and separate launch decision.

tickets.title: Establish the React/TypeScript application and build checks
tickets.outcome: Create a locked static application that future work can build and verify.
scope: Initialize React/TypeScript/Vite with a supported Node LTS and static build. Add meaningful type/lint/build checks and fixture test entry points.
Define module boundaries for controller, rules, clocks, proofs, archive/replay, storage, providers and cloud ordering. UI emits intents and renders committed state.
Add MIT original-code license and initial dependency/asset notice inventory. Use the approved prototype as reference, without merging disposable source.
done: A clean checkout installs reproducibly and passes documented checks.
Static build contains no server generation relay or administrative secrets; distribution notices start with actual selected versions.

tickets.title: Implement strict orthodox rules, FEN and repetition state
tickets.outcome: Expose authoritative legal transitions and exact setup state behind the chess.js adapter.
scope: Validate all six FEN fields and actionable current-state consistency, not historical reachability. Preserve decimal counters and valid rights outside lossy library state.
Own repetition identity/ledger, including legally usable en passant, imported ineffective-EP and rights changes.

Handle legal moves, king safety, castling, en passant, all promotions and actual third repetition/100-halfmove rules with checkmate precedence. Generic library draw flags cannot declare exact deadness.
done: Independent expected fixtures cover all special moves, boundary counters, custom unreachable-but-consistent boards and repetition equivalence.
No silent piece-count/four-digit limit, counter rounding or legal-move advice to the model.

tickets.title: Build atomic local checkpoints and lossless game archives
tickets.outcome: Make committed game state and received content recoverable without hiding storage failures.
scope: Implement IndexedDB append-only chunks/events, current/discarded line references, versioned atomic checkpoints and idempotent outbox records.
Wait for transaction completion. Store all rules/history/clock/budget/selection/result/practice state, never FEN alone. No transaction spans a network wait.
Add full versioned export/import, persistent-storage request/status, quota/upgrade/abort recovery and accurate memory/local/sync status.
Keep game/export/sync DTOs separate from credentials; recognized credential echoes remain exact locally and block affected egress. Document receive-to-commit crash limits.
done: Digest/event-order round trips preserve multibyte/unknown/duplicate fields and discarded data.
Fault injection proves no false saved state, silent pruning or secret export.

tickets.title: Implement serialized match transitions and continuous clocks
tickets.outcome: Give one browser controller authority over moves, effective event times and immutable results.
scope: Define versioned intents/events carrying game, segment, side, revision, request/analysis generation and ownership epoch. Fence duplicates, old callbacks and React remounts.
Implement 15+10 default, White/Black/Random setup, single increments and continuously running deadlines across errors/Stop/Undo/navigation/closure/sleep.

Reconcile time before actions. Sample decision time before checkpoint write; expiry wins at or beyond deadline. Await commit before accepting a move/follow-up; charge commit delay to next bank. Abort grants no move.
Preserve monotonic/wall/host reference evidence and detected clock discrepancies. Support unresolved candidate events so later adjudication cannot rewrite a final result.
done: Deterministic before/equal/after-deadline, delayed-commit, abort and repeated-FEN races resolve once.
Restore/closure/sleep fixtures grant no new time or retrospective abandoned move; native verification remains downstream.

tickets.title: Implement checked mating witnesses and sound impossibility proofs
tickets.outcome: Accept exact adjudication evidence only through reviewed independent checks.
scope: Specify cooperative legal-move-only mating predicate, separate global deadness and opponent-only timeout queries, and ignore hypothetical future count/repetition draws.
Replay every positive witness to legal intended-color checkmate. Implement only reviewed negative sufficient proofs with explicit checked preconditions.
Define closed-set certificate validation that regenerates every legal successor and compares full states. Keep all proof output out of model advice.
Bypass the unsafe stock Rust custom-input/witness path unless it is comprehensively repaired and reviewed. Do not execute the unchecked 21-origin hazard or trust unsupported negative deductions.
done: Review the trusted transition/checker assumptions and reject missing/partial/illegal/wrong-color/corrupt evidence.
Use dead wall, asymmetric mirrors, bare king/rook, knight support, two knights and counter-99 controls with independently justified expectations.

tickets.title: Build resumable exact cooperative graph analysis
tickets.outcome: Provide the complete graph fallback while preserving honest resource unknowns.
scope: Implement full-state visited/frontier/parent records and complete legal-successor exploration for either target winner.
Produce a checked positive path or complete negative closure; partial frontiers, hash collisions and skipped successors cannot yield a verdict.
Start with a 10,000-discovered-state and five-second foreground pass policy, chunked validated checkpoints and explicit resume/cancel. A timer is not a hard real-time guarantee.
Version checkpoints by predicate/rules/schema/proof implementation and restart incompatible/corrupt checkpoints safely. Treat the researched 128 MiB WASM linear cap separately from total memory.
done: Exhaust small known finite graphs correctly and replay positives; fault/resource/corruption controls remain unknown.
The real five-second unknown fixture stays honest. No universal practical completion or mobile memory claim.

tickets.title: Integrate exact endings and saved pending adjudication
tickets.outcome: Connect proof results to setup, game endings and original event-time ordering.
scope: Classify setup before clocks or game diagnostic. Save unresolved setup with Start unavailable and editable state.
During play save query, position, ordered candidate/expiry facts and checkpoint; stop play with Adjudication pending and no promised finish time while an unexpired clock runs.
Add explicit Continue/Stop analysis. Fence stale/canceled/ownership-changed results; do not restart expensive analysis indefinitely.
At flag record original expiry, stop actionable generation, and settle earlier unresolved deadness/flag candidate only with checked evidence. Never rewrite accepted result.
done: Setup/in-game unknown, late proof, expiry, reload and stale-generation races preserve exact facts and no guessed win/draw.
Known supported proofs yield correct global/one-sided endings; unsupported queries can remain pending.

tickets.title: Add guest recovery, Undo, rematch and timed practice
tickets.outcome: Complete local match lifecycle without rewriting results or discarded context.
scope: Restore full guest game/checkpoint and reconcile expiry before enabling actions. Abandoned requests need explicit recovery.
Undo to previous human decision, restore rules/ledger/budgets/selection and archive discarded records without replay or summary. Fence queued/inflight work and advance versions.
Keep elapsed charges, remove undone increments and reject nonpositive banks. No increment farming or erasure of earlier expiry.

Restart/rematch/custom edits create separate games. Explicit unscored post-model-loss practice gets fresh clocks/context/budgets after diagnostic while retaining actual rules/repetition and original result.
done: Round trips and repeated Undo prove archive/replay separation, correct time charges and boundary behavior.
No automatic practice, terminal-board generation, context leakage or final-result rewrite.

tickets.title: Implement direct-browser connection profiles and local credentials
tickets.outcome: Let players deliberately configure routes and credentials without hidden requests or secret egress.
scope: Implement OpenAI/Responses, OpenRouter/Chat, Anthropic/Messages defaults and explicit protocol alternatives/custom profiles; preserve path prefixes and show final generation/catalog URLs.
Support configured auth/header modes, destination-bound secret assignment, omitted fetch credentials and redirect rejection.
Default to device-local saved keys with replace/forget/clear-all and truthful write failures; separate guest/account-UUID namespaces.
Profile edit/save sends nothing; explicit Check connection is catalog-only. Include accurate first-request disclosure and scoped network errors without CORS guesses or automatic retries.
done: Synthetic network/redirect/secret-canary and storage fixtures pass for each profile.
Another device receives no keys and requires deliberate local binding; optional loopback/LAN claims remain scoped.

tickets.title: Implement Chat, Responses and Messages streaming adapters
tickets.outcome: Translate browser-direct provider wires into complete attributed records and actionable completion states.
scope: Implement each documented protocol's auth/headers/request/stream/completion/error rules, including eligible native Anthropic browser access and ZDR restriction.
Accumulate answer/reasoning/choices/tool/unknown fields separately, preserve raw received data and do not act on partial output.
Map normal terminal events explicitly. Chat stop and proper stream termination are both required; DONE alone is insufficient.
Implement Stop/abort fencing and explicit technical recovery with no tools executed, hidden network retries, model/protocol fallback or extra app generation timeout.
done: Fragmented/interleaved/multibyte/error/filter/truncation/tool/late/duplicate fixture corpus passes across all three adapters.
No synthetic result is described as authenticated generation; live verification remains separate.

tickets.title: Implement move parsing and independent recovery budgets
tickets.outcome: Classify completed model replies exactly once without choosing the model's move.
scope: Parse completed choice-zero coordinate JSON/optional plan or explicit resignation; allow documented single-fence/final-Move/standalone fallback. Reject ambiguity/conflicting duplicate keys and missing promotion.
Never read commands from reasoning/plans/history/other choices or repair JSON strategically.
Apply rule-specific corrections without legal-move lists; initial plus three illegal retries, fourth illegal loss. Keep three independent automatic format corrections with no chess loss.
Manual Retry authorizes one request without refilling budgets; ordinary switches/technical errors preserve them. Explicit complete refusal resigns; quoted/filter/provider errors do not.
done: Independent adversarial parser/refusal and mixed illegal/format/technical/switch fixtures prove counts and attribution.
Stop/expiry/stale events cannot spend attempts, add increments or change results.

tickets.title: Implement full-history replay, prompt caching and cost accounting
tickets.outcome: Send complete retained history with reusable prefixes and transparent native usage accounting.
scope: Build losslessly escaped attributed historical transcript and fresh current FEN/piece/color/clock suffix. Preserve received plans/reasoning/opaque data without inventing native private state.
Cover all nine ordered protocol pairs. Undo excludes discarded line, and capacity checks/rejections never trim, summarize, reset or substitute.
Keep instructions/history prefixes stable and use documented selected-model/protocol cache body/session controls; whole-response replay is not prompt caching.

Preserve raw billed categories/rates/currency/date. Distinguish provider-measured charges, rate estimates and unknowns; include diagnostics/retries/failures and avoid input/cache/reasoning double-counting.
done: Payload comparisons prove complete attribution, fresh time, stable prefix and correct Undo/capacity behavior.
Provider-specific accounting fixtures pass; no fixed price target, allowlist or synthetic cache-hit claim.

tickets.title: Implement model catalogs, diagnostics and queued handoffs
tickets.outcome: Support every advertised/manual selection with explicit compatibility evidence and safe switching.
scope: Implement scoped exact IDs, aliases/logos, pagination, partial/stale/removed/cooldown catalogs and manual entry without capability/name guesses.
Run disclosed fixed-coordinate/unique-prior-plan diagnostics before new-game/practice clocks. Keep diagnostic budgets/history separate.
Reuse unchanged current-session midgame passes and invalidate material route/protocol/adapter/credential/options/routing or session/device changes.

Queue until active response settles, replace candidates, distinguish committed/queued/producing identities and commit only first interpretable real candidate reply. Failed candidate needs explicit recovery; no prior-model auto-fallback.
done: Discovery/marker/reuse/invalidation and queued/error/Undo/expiry race fixtures pass with exact request counts.
All retained history travels on real moves; catalogs/diagnostics imply no full-match/cache/backend certification.

tickets.title: Build the accessible Classic match board and position editor
tickets.outcome: Implement the approved board/player/clock and details layout with shared-controller inputs.
scope: Use cm-chessboard within approved A Classic workspace, normal Chess.com arrangement and actual T3 themes; keep disposable prototype off main.
Connect mouse/touch/keyboard/coordinate forms to one controller with named square/piece inspection, orientation and explicit four-piece promotion.
Implement FEN/visual editor, field/square errors, terminal/pending setup, clocks, Undo, results, new games and practice.
Provide semantic focus/restoration, responsive zoom/reflow, contrast and reduced-motion behavior; clock ticks must not cause speech chatter.
done: Synthetic controller journeys and accessibility checks show no duplicate transitions or obscured actions.
All input/promotion/editor controls are available to keyboard/AT. Actual native screen-reader certification is downstream.

tickets.title: Build connection, opponent and recovery journeys
tickets.outcome: Expose connection/model state and recovery clearly throughout the approved workspace.
scope: Implement profiles, catalogs/manual IDs, quota-bearing diagnostic disclosure and committed/producing/queued identities.
Connect provider/format/capacity errors, Stop/Retry/Switch/Resume, archive/conversation, save status and pending analysis with continuous clocks.
Make setup/dialogs/errors/focus/announcements work for complete screen-reader journeys and preserve original-result/practice distinctions.
Display measured/estimated/unknown costs honestly, with no fixed affordability gate or repeated consent flow.
done: End-to-end fixture journeys cover failed switches, errors, Undo, practice, save failure, pending and expiry without lost focus.
No UI element executes generation or adjudicates independently; real AT observations remain required.

tickets.title: Implement owner-only Supabase schema and revision operations
tickets.outcome: Create database migrations and transactional storage ordering without server chess authority.
scope: Define versioned owner-only game/chunk/checkpoint/ownership/outbox metadata with RLS on every table/RPC/access path.
Implement expected-revision/epoch CAS, idempotent operation lookup, immutable finals and deletion tombstones. Remove direct-write/upsert bypass.
Use browser publishable key/user sessions only; keep service-role/admin keys out of bundle.
Prepare migration and local test fixtures; deployed two-user denial and bypass checks must also run after staging setup.
done: Database tests cover two users/unauthenticated access, stale revision/epoch, duplicate/lost acknowledgment, immutable results and tombstones.
No hosted operation decides chess legality or receives AI secrets.

tickets.title: Implement Google PKCE accounts and identity isolation
tickets.outcome: Add optional accounts without changing guest clocks, keys or ownership.
scope: Implement Google OAuth explicit PKCE, exact callbacks, refresh, canceled/overlapping/expired/missing-verifier flows and native return-context support.
Offer explicit guest import preserving IDs/results/current/discarded/practice state. Another device deliberately rebinds its local AI connection.
Sign-out fences requests, deletes departing account's AI keys, clears in-memory identity and hides private views. Retain cached games/outbox under original UUID for same-account recovery.
Add explicit remove-device warning for unsynced data; prevent account A/guest/B inheritance. No clock reset or implicit email-auth/SMTP path.
done: A-to-B-to-A, offline sign-out/import and auth-recovery fixtures preserve isolation and continuous time.
Deployed callback/native-device checks are linked execution evidence; account UI remains accessible.

tickets.title: Implement cloud sync, takeover and preserved conflicts
tickets.outcome: Keep one accepted cloud history while retaining offline local continuations.
scope: Coordinate tabs with Web Locks plus IndexedDB epoch/revision fencing and channel notices, with transactional fallback.
Sync immutable deltas/checkpoints idempotently; query uncertain operation IDs and explicitly take over from last acknowledged cloud state.
Allow offline local play with unsynced warning and live deadlines. Preserve divergence separately; no automatic branch merge, last-write-wins or stale overwrite of Undo/finals/deletion.
Sync pending query/event facts while analysis frontiers remain local. Apply owner deletion across records/chunks/caches/outbox and tombstones.
done: True-device network partition/takeover/reconnect and two-tab fallback tests preserve both accepted history and separate conflict.
No promise of immediate offline revocation notice, globally stopped provider requests or server chess authority.

tickets.title: Prepare free-tier HTTPS staging and auth configuration
tickets.outcome: Establish an owned staging route for deployed/native verification and record operating limits.
scope: Prepare Cloudflare Pages static HTTPS/deep links, Supabase project/migrations, exact Google redirects and publishable config on managed free tiers.
Configure/review CSP, Worker/WASM MIME and explicit direct endpoint profiles. Do not cache auth/private/provider traffic as generic assets.
Measure schema/archive capacity and document quotas, inactivity pausing/read-only modes and local/outbox recovery; no synthetic keepalive dependency.
Keep public account storage disabled until backup/restore readiness and public release approval. Use only deliberate test accounts/data for staging.
done: Staging build and config evidence demonstrate direct browser boundaries, callback/error routes and versioning.
Current no-cost limits/recovery are documented; return specific unmet constraints before any paid upgrade.
tickets.gate: Creating this ticket provisions nothing. Execution needs owner-controlled hosting/auth access and approved production/staging origins. Free tiers only; any paid upgrade returns to the owner.

tickets.title: Implement encrypted backups, restore and deletion recovery
tickets.outcome: Demonstrate protected account data and no-cost capacity before public account storage.
scope: Configure private encrypted logical exports and automation at a verified no-cost destination.
Target daily exports with seven daily/four weekly rotation; restore all chunks/checkpoints and reapply deletion tombstones through the rotation.
Rehearse quota/pause/read-only/failure, lost backup/credentials and stale offline resurrection recovery with truthful retention limits.
Maintain owner export/deletion behavior and no application age purge; separate live removal from eventual backup expiry.
done: Actual backup/automation/rotation/restore digest and deletion rehearsal evidence exists.
If no-cost feasibility fails, record the concrete operating constraint and return it before claiming protected public storage or purchasing.
tickets.gate: Execution requires owner-controlled private backup destination and secret access through approved private entry. Ticket creation authorizes no provisioning or spending.

tickets.title: Verify integrated rules, recovery and concurrency invariants
tickets.outcome: Produce integrated evidence that module interactions preserve the approved contract.
scope: Run independent expected fixtures and fault/race scenarios against the actual integrated build, not a reproduction of implementation internals.
Cover protocol completion/parser/budgets, full-history/Undo archives, rules/repetition, checked proofs/pending, commit/expiry and duplicate/ownership races.
Exercise quota/crash/checkpoint/auth/import/delete/outbox conflicts and secret-canary egress, including deployed database denial checks.
Update acceptance evidence with build/date/method/expected/observed/artifact/limits. Preserve unrun native/live coverage rather than marking parent cases passed prematurely.
done: All applicable deterministic/build/cloud fixture subruns have evidence and actionable failures resolved.
No research/prototype/synthetic result is counted as native/AT/live/cache/cost certification.

tickets.title: Run native Windows and macOS screen-reader acceptance
tickets.outcome: Validate actual desktop browser and AT journeys on the shipped candidate.
scope: Run stable Windows Chrome+NVDA, Edge+NVDA, Firefox+NVDA and macOS Safari+VoiceOver on actual devices.
Complete setup, a legal full game, board/coordinate inspection, all promotions, custom setup, diagnostics/switches, errors/Stop/Retry, Undo/practice, dialogs/focus, pending and expiry/results.
Exercise native storage/credentials, stream/abort, Worker/MIME/CSP, sleep/closure/time anomaly and OAuth returns. Record versions/devices/origin/input and actual AT observations.
Use fixture transport where live authorization is absent; record it accurately and leave provider-specific live subruns unrun.
done: Every desktop target has evidence for required native/AT subruns; no timer-tick speech, focus traps or pointer-only actions.
Emulation/Helium/automated scans are supporting evidence only; log missing devices as unmet prerequisites.
tickets.gate: Requires actual Windows/macOS devices and NVDA/VoiceOver. No credentials or live usage implied.

tickets.title: Run native iOS and Android screen-reader acceptance
tickets.outcome: Validate actual mobile browser, touch and AT journeys on the shipped candidate.
scope: Run stable iOS Safari+VoiceOver and Android Chrome+TalkBack on actual representative devices.
Complete the same full-game/setup/editor/promotion/error/switch/Undo/practice/pending/result journeys with touch/AT gestures and representative external-keyboard access.
Exercise native storage/credential re-entry, OAuth return context, Worker resources, background/sleep/closure and time reconciliation.
Use fixture transport without live permission and leave exact provider live coverage to its gate; do not infer phone-to-PC proxy access from desktop loopback.
done: Both native targets have versioned device/AT/input evidence and all required mobile journeys pass.
No viewport emulation, mobile memory guarantee or blanket local-network certification.
tickets.gate: Requires actual iOS/Android devices and VoiceOver/TalkBack. No credentials or live usage implied.

tickets.title: Audit credential boundaries, deployed configuration and licenses
tickets.outcome: Verify the distribution and hosted setup meet the approved privacy and operations boundaries.
scope: Review actual bundle/network/CSP/telemetry/export/sync paths with secret canaries, untrusted provider HTML/errors and destination changes.
Verify two-user RLS/CAS and no administrative or AI key leakage, unsafe solver entry, native-state replay shortcuts or generated server relay.
Reconcile pinned dependencies/assets/licenses and art credits/modifications, excluding optional NonCommercial pieces and research-only GPL replay code.
Inspect free capacity, backup/restore/deletion evidence and public-account disabled state before release.
done: A reproducible security/configuration/license report identifies actual build and tested boundaries; findings are fixed or explicit launch blockers.
No blanket security or universal solver proof claim from finite samples.

tickets.title: Verify authorized provider routes and cross-provider handoffs
tickets.outcome: Gather exact authenticated route evidence across required native platforms.
scope: Choose exact available model/connection/protocol versions with the owner at execution. No fixed model-family trio or capability allowlist.

Across all six native targets exercise OpenAI Responses, OpenRouter Chat, eligible native Anthropic Messages and public HTTPS custom Chat/CLIProxyAPI baseline: diagnostic, legal move/full-history continuation, Stop and explicit recovery.
Test explicit alternative routes before calling them verified. Record unknown/blocked/account restrictions honestly; optional local routes need separate qualified evidence.
Exercise live Chat-to-Responses, Responses-to-Messages and Messages-to-Chat plus return to checked unchanged selection, received plans, failed candidate, Undo and capacity rejection.
done: Per-route/target records identify actual requested/reported IDs, adapter/build/origin, outcomes, raw usage and limits.
Synthetic transport/diagnostic evidence never certifies every catalog model/custom deployment or pooled backend.
tickets.gate: Requires explicit exact-configuration approval, private credentials and live/spend authorization at execution. This ticket and project creation authorize no model call.

tickets.title: Measure prompt-cache behavior and reference-game costs
tickets.outcome: Show real cache/usage evidence with no fixed price benchmark.
scope: Demonstrate a real warm prompt-cache read on at least one eligible configuration while generating fresh moves with complete retained history.
Measure cold/warm/expiry/long-pause/Undo/retry/provider-switch behavior and native write/read/uncached/output/reasoning categories.
Include billed diagnostics/corrections/retries/failed requests and reconcile native categories/rates/available charge records without double-counting.

Report actual turns/requests/outcomes/tokens/history growth/latency/cost and about-40-turn reference. Label projections/assumptions separately; never pad an ended game or call early failure proof of cheap full-history play.
done: Raw authorized per-request usage supports scoped cache claims and measured/estimated/unknown accounting.
No dollar ceiling, price-based model restriction, promised cache hit or platform-funded usage.
tickets.gate: Requires separately agreed runs, private credentials and explicit spend authorization. No live request or spending is authorized by creating this ticket.

tickets.title: Complete the acceptance evidence review and release handoff
tickets.outcome: Make the production readiness decision reviewable against all 79 approved cases.
scope: Review every required applicable coverage subrun for the actual candidate build, using acceptance evidence records and scoped route claims.
Ensure fixtures, native/AT, deployed cloud/auth/conflict/restore, live handoff and actual cache/cost evidence remain distinct. Required fail/blocked/unrun is no waiver.
Verify exact accepted verdicts or correctly saved pending cases, no universal practical-completion promise, immutable results and truthful free-tier/data limits.
Prepare public release/rollback/recovery documentation, dependency notices and account-storage enablement steps; present concrete release result to owner for final launch decision.
done: All 79 cases have complete applicable evidence and no hidden required failure/unrun subrun, or the release remains blocked with precise reasons.
Owner launch decision is recorded before publishing/enabling public accounts; specification approval is not launch approval.
tickets.gate: Public release and account-storage enablement require the owner's separate final launch decision. This planning task executes neither.
